Locate an attribute or factor metadata template

find_template.Rd

find_template locates an entity's attribute or factor metadata template (e.g., my_table_attrs.yaml) in the metadata_path directory or the working directory.

Usage

find_template(
  name,
  type = c("attrs", "factors"),
  metadata_path = NULL,
  also = NULL,
  extensions = c("yaml", "csv"),
  must_exist = FALSE
)

Arguments

name

(character) The quoted name of the data entity.

type

(character) The template type: "attrs" or "factors".

metadata_path

(character) Directory of metadata templates. Defaults to metadata_path in config.yaml, else the working directory.

also

(character) Additional directories to search (e.g., the directory of a data file for templates co-located with the data).

extensions

(character) Template file extensions to consider, in order of precedence.

must_exist

(logical) Whether to raise an error if a template is not found.

Value

The path to the template, or NULL if a template is not found and must_exist is FALSE.

Details

Within a directory, a yaml template takes precedence over a csv template. An error is raised if a template for the entity is found in more than one directory so that a stale copy is never used silently.
